subject: Copywriting
title: Temporal Landmarks in Copy
description: Learn Temporal Landmarks in Copy in one minute.

hook.text: Gym sign-ups spike on January 1, Mondays, and birthdays. People are motivated by fresh-start moments.

buildup.text: The 'fresh start effect'—identified by Dai, Milkman, and Riis—shows that temporal landmarks boost motivation.

discovery.text: 'New Year, New You' campaigns exploit this. Copy timed to Mondays and month-starts converts higher.

twist.text: The effect fades fast. By January 15, gym attendance drops 50%. Copy must capture impulse before motivation dies.

climax.text: Smart copy creates its own fresh starts: 'Start your 30-day challenge today.' Any day becomes a landmark.

punchline.text: New week, new month, new you. Timing is copy's ally.

quiz.question: What is the 'fresh start effect'?
options: Temporal landmarks boost motivation for new behaviors

details.summary: Temporal landmarks — New Year's, Mondays, birthdays, back-to-school season — create natural moments of fresh-start motivation. Copy timed to these landmarks taps into people's desire for reinvention, making them more receptive to products that promise transformation.
details.whyItMatters: Timing a message to coincide with a fresh-start moment dramatically increases its persuasive power. People are more open to change at temporal landmarks, making these the ideal moments for transformative product messaging.
takeaways: The 'fresh start effect' makes people more motivated at temporal landmarks
New Year's, Mondays, and birthdays are peak motivation moments
Copy that references fresh starts converts better during these windows

faq.question: What is the fresh start effect?
faq.answer: Research by Katherine Milkman shows people are more likely to pursue goals after temporal landmarks — dates that feel like new beginnings. These moments create a psychological separation from past failures, allowing people to feel like a 'new self' who can succeed.

faq.question: How can copywriters use the fresh start effect?
faq.answer: Time campaigns to coincide with temporal landmarks and reference the fresh start explicitly: 'New year, new skills,' 'Start your week right,' 'It's not too late to become who you want to be.' The copy should name the moment and connect it to the product's transformative promise.
